statements.text: KRISTIANIA BEDRIFTSIDRETTSLAG, with organisation number 996569071, is a legal form FLI registered on 2011-02-16 and founded on 1984-09-03.
The company operates as a sports club and association under industry code 93.120, serving as a corporate sports team for employees at Høyskolen Kristiania - Ernst G Mortensens Stiftelse.
The board consists of Kamilla Kolvig as chair, alongside board members Knut Erik Gaustad, Sindre Sommerfelt, and Morten Michaelsen Gjestrud.
Between the periods of 2023-12-31 and 2024-12-31, revenue increased by 51,705 NOK from 432,545 NOK to 484,250 NOK, and subsequently decreased by 172,471 NOK to 311,779 NOK by 2025-12-31.
Operating results changed from -44,019 NOK in 2023 to 22,405 NOK in 2024, and further improved to 25,248 NOK by the end of 2025.
There is no information regarding the specific details of operations beyond registered activities and public announcements.
